rules.title: Replace System.out.println with logger
rules.defaultGuidance: Replace direct console printing with the project's logging style using the smallest safe change.

rules.title: Replace empty catch with handling
rules.defaultGuidance: Replace the empty catch block with minimal safe handling, usually logging with exception context.

rules.title: Replace loop string concat with StringBuilder
rules.defaultGuidance: Replace repeated string concatenation inside loops with StringBuilder while preserving exact output semantics.

rules.title: Replace temp with query
rules.defaultGuidance: Inline or remove temporary values only when doing so keeps the code clearer and behavior-preserving.

rules.title: Cache collection size before loop
rules.defaultGuidance: Cache collection size before the loop only when doing so preserves loop semantics exactly.

rules.title: Replace legacy collections
rules.defaultGuidance: Modernize legacy collections conservatively and preserve thread-safety intent when present.

rules.title: Add generics to raw types
rules.defaultGuidance: Add the narrowest safe generic type parameters supported by local code evidence.

rules.title: Replace wildcard imports
rules.defaultGuidance: Replace wildcard imports with the explicit classes actually used in the file.

rules.title: Extract method
rules.defaultGuidance: Use conservative Extract Method style refactors that improve readability without redesigning the class.

rules.title: Introduce parameter object
rules.defaultGuidance: Introduce a tiny parameter object only when multiple related arguments clearly travel together.

rules.title: Modernize instanceof pattern matching
rules.defaultGuidance: Modernize eligible instanceof checks to pattern matching while preserving control flow and meaning.

rules.title: Refactor switch to pattern matching
rules.defaultGuidance: Use modern switch and pattern matching forms only when the surrounding code already fits them cleanly.

rules.title: Replace nested conditional with guard clauses
rules.defaultGuidance: Flatten the most obvious nested branch with guard clauses or one tiny helper, preserving exact behavior.

rules.title: Extract duplicate logic
rules.defaultGuidance: Extract the repeated local logic into the smallest clear helper or shared branch.

rules.title: Harden null-sensitive calls
rules.defaultGuidance: Make null-sensitive dereferences safe with the smallest guard or null-safe call order change.

rules.title: Cache repeated method calls
rules.defaultGuidance: Cache the repeated method or property lookup in a narrow local variable when semantics are stable.

rules.title: Tell don't ask
rules.defaultGuidance: Move decision-making closer to the object that owns the state, favoring a tiny behavior-preserving helper over external state peeking.

rules.title: Single responsibility extraction
rules.defaultGuidance: Extract one cohesive responsibility at a time instead of broad redesign.

rules.title: Replace conditional with polymorphism
rules.defaultGuidance: Prefer polymorphism only when repeated branching is stable and object boundaries are already present.

rules.title: Avoid unneeded abstractions
rules.defaultGuidance: Avoid introducing new abstractions unless they directly simplify the target change.
